instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Traps: only edit listed trap .c. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: Coin: heal or burn destroyed ATK. When a monster is destroyed by a card effect: toss a coin. Heads: its controller gains LP equal to total ATK. Tails: they take that much damage.
Lightsworn mill: banish opp top. Each time a card(s) is sent from your Deck to the Graveyard by the effect of a Lightsworn monster, remove from play the top card of your opponent's Deck.
If Reptile destroyed: SS Lv4- Reptile from Deck. Activate only when a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.
Opp Attack Position 0 ATK monsters cannot be destroyed by battle. Face-up Attack Position monsters with 0 ATK your opponent controls cannot be destroyed by battle with Reptilianne monsters.
